html:
<cs-progress-ring [value]="complete()" [max]="movements().length" />
@for (movement of movements(); track movement.id) {
  <button
    type="button"
    [disabled]="movement.state === 'locked'"
    (click)="activated.emit({ movementId: movement.id })"
  >
    {{ movement.label }}
  </button>
}
